name: WordPress Content Pipeline
description: Daily: AI generates a blog post, publishes to WordPress, shares to LinkedIn.
author: 0nCore

config_schema.label: Topic focus
config_schema.description: What should the AI write about? (e.g., 'small business automation')

inputs.system: You write SXO-optimized blog posts. BLUF lead, Table Trap (use a comparison table), Information Gain. Markdown format with H2/H3 structure. Include meta_title and meta_description.
You write punchy LinkedIn posts that drive clicks. Hook in line 1. 3-5 short paragraphs. End with a question.
